title: Deployment Slots and Custom Domains
description: Use staging slots to validate releases and bind a custom domain to your ASP.NET Core app.

data.text: Before a release reaches all users, you want a safe place to test it. Deployment slots give you exactly that, and custom domains make your app recognizable.
In the Azure portal, open your App Service and select **Deployment slots**. Click **Add Slot**, name it `staging`, and clone settings from production.

data.title: Deploy to a staging slot with Azure CLI
data.content: Deploy directly to the staging slot instead of production.
data.code:
az webapp deployment slot create \
  --name azure-for-aspnet-demo \
  --resource-group azure-for-aspnet-rg \
  --slot staging \
  --configuration-source azure-for-aspnet-demo

# Deploy zip to staging
az webapp deploy \
  --name azure-for-aspnet-demo \
  --resource-group azure-for-aspnet-rg \
  --src-path ./publish.zip \
  --slot staging

data.text: Swapping moves the staging content to production and the old production content to staging. Use the Azure CLI to automate swaps in a release pipeline.

data.title: Swap staging into production
data.content: A swap is instant for most App Service configurations.
data.code:
az webapp deployment slot swap \
  --name azure-for-aspnet-demo \
  --resource-group azure-for-aspnet-rg \
  --slot staging \
  --target-slot production

items: Add a DNS `CNAME` record pointing your domain to `azure-for-aspnet-demo.azurewebsites.net`
In the portal, go to **Custom domains** and add the domain
Enable **HTTPS Only** and use the built-in App Service certificate or upload your own

data.title: Slot settings
data.text: Mark connection strings, app settings, and Key Vault references as 'slot setting' so they stay with the slot and do not swap unexpectedly.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Deployment slots let you validate releases before swapping to production
Swapping preserves hostnames and avoids downtime
Custom domains require a DNS record and portal verification
Use HTTPS Only and slot settings for safer deployments
data.takeaway: Slots turn App Service from a simple host into a safe release platform for ASP.NET Core apps.
